about_the_game:
• This DLC provides 4K high-definition versions of all videos in the main game.

  • This DLC contains video files of the main game, with an upgraded graphics quality to 4K HD.

  • This expansion pack provides 4K high-definition video content for the main game and needs to be used in conjunction with the main game.

Instructions for use:

First download and install the main game package, then manually download the DLC content to experience 4K graphics quality in the game.

content_descriptors.notes:
Mild Violence: Non-bloody fighting scenes.
Realistic Violence: Includes blood (e.g., gunshots, stabbings), group fights, and humiliating violent scenes.
Language: Contains mild profanity, swearing, and curses.
Suicide: Depicts character suicide (e.g., using a grenade to die together with enemies).
Criminal Acts: Includes kidnapping, assault, gambling, and interrogation with restraints.
Horror Elements: Enclosed spaces (e.g., attics) and ghosts (spirit forms of deceased characters).
Sexual Content: Revealing clothing (swimsuits, bikinis), partial nudity or implied nudity (e.g., bare back while changing clothes, body close-ups during dancing).
Legal Drugs: Depictions of drinking and smoking.
Adult Venues: Features bars, casinos, and nightclubs.
Illegal Drugs: Includes use of knockout drugs (causing unconsciousness after inhalation or drinking).

short_description: Freshly graduated, you head to Bangkok’s Chinatown to find your uncle—only to lose contact. Seeking a steady job, you’re mistaken for a gang boss and thrown into chaos. Along the way, you meet a sweet cousin, cold widow, mysterious performer, quirky ghost, and even... someone unexpected.
